entries.title: Rust absent from Windows matrix job
entries.root_cause: The Windows matrix job invokes Cargo without installing the Rust toolchain; the toolchain setup is restricted to Linux.

entries.title: Go absent from Windows matrix job
entries.root_cause: The Windows matrix job invokes Go without installing the Go toolchain; the Go setup is restricted to Linux.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The same Windows matrix setup omission affects Go rather than Rust and requires installing Go.

entries.title: Cargo unavailable in Windows build
entries.root_cause: The Windows matrix job invokes Cargo without installing the Rust toolchain; the toolchain setup is restricted to Linux.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later pull request runs a different Cargo subcommand on a newer Windows runner.

entries.title: Windows test job cannot find Cargo
entries.root_cause: The Windows matrix job invokes Cargo without installing the Rust toolchain; the toolchain setup is restricted to Linux.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later push runs tests through PowerShell after restoring a cache, with different runner and checkout details.
